d: On 12 February 1938, Austria's chancellor Kurt Schuschnigg crossed the border into Bavaria to meet Adolf Hitler at his mountain home. Hitler greeted him politely on the front steps and took him upstairs to a room with a view of the mountains. When Schuschnigg tried to open with a word about the view, Hitler cut him short: they had not come to talk about the view or the weather. By 11 that night Schuschnigg had signed Hitler's demands, and a month later Austria had been swallowed by Germany. The house where this happened was the Berghof.
